placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The play areas at Salthouse Fields give a Clevedon visit a natural starting point for children. There is space to pause on the grass between play sessions, with the seafront offering a change of scene afterwards.

Our family idea: make the playground the main event and leave the rest of the afternoon open. If the model railway is operating, decide together whether to add a ride; it is a separate paid activity.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who want playtime and a relaxed seaside setting.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Children's play areas, skate park and nearby seafront amenities.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed Salthouse Fields or seafront parking and check charges.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Playground entry is free. Check equipment suitability for each child and supervise them near the adjoining roads and water.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit

placevisitmap.travelNote: Use signed Salthouse Fields or seafront parking and check charges. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
